name: Mani Gopi Reddy Challa
headline: Java Full Stack Developer | DevOps and Production Support Engineer
summary: Java Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience delivering secure, scalable microservices (Spring Boot, Kafka, React.js) for an enterprise telecom client. Currently supporting and modernising a large collections platform, covering production support, incident and root cause management, CI/CD and Kubernetes releases, and Oracle GoldenGate data replication to Azure Databricks. Skilled in API security (OAuth 2.0/JWT, Entra ID) and cross-team coordination. AZ-900 and ISTQB certified.
